lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Restraints, Open Truck Beds & Unattended Children
prompt: Why can interior vehicle temperatures reach lethal levels within ten minutes in Texas sun?

options.text: Automotive engine blocks radiate excessive residual combustion heat into car
Vehicle battery charging circuits vent high-temperature thermal vapor gases
Cracking side windows causes vacuum currents that draw heated outdoor air
Greenhouse effect traps solar radiation, heating cabin by 20 degrees in 10 mins
